about.title: About Darbi
about.lead: Darbi (دربي) means "my path". It is a school bus tracking system built for UAE schools, and a demonstration of what a live activity can feel like on the web.
about.problemBody: Parents wait at the kerb with no idea whether the bus is two minutes or twenty minutes away. Schools field phone calls they cannot answer. When a bus is delayed, nobody finds out until it is already late.
about.solutionBody: One ID number opens a live map, a stop-by-stop progress rail and a countdown that keeps running on the lock screen. No parent account, no app store, no waiting.
about.techBody: React, TypeScript and Framer Motion on the front, Node, Express and Socket.IO on the back, SQLite for data, MapLibre for maps. The server ticks every trip four times a second and pushes each frame to whoever is watching.
about.demoBody: Demo Mode simulates a whole journey inside the browser. The admin console does the opposite: it drives a real viewer's screen from another device, which is how the live presentation is run.
about.phaseBody: The Dynamic Island here is a faithful web simulation. A native iOS app using ActivityKit would put the same feed in the real Dynamic Island and on the real Lock Screen, driven by the same server payload.
